title: davallia maxima
intro: Davallia maxima, commonly known as the Water Spout Fern or Horse's Teeth, is a species of fern native to Australia and parts of Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its ability to lower cholesterol levels and blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Davallia maxima include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and immune system support. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
